/**
 * Public LLM proxy — POST /api/ai/v1/chat/completions (OpenAI-compatible).
 *
 * OAuth-bearer route that mirrors the OpenAI chat completions wire format so
 * OpenAI-compatible clients (e.g. Studio via OpenRouter SDK) can route
 * through Webflow's internal LLM proxy without code changes. Lives under
 * `/api/ai/*` so webflow-proxy's existing `location /api/ai` prefix rule
 * lands it on the `webflow-app-ai` shard.
 *
 * Design: docs/public-llm-proxy-design.md (PR #116484)
 * Ticket: PION-768
 */
import type {Request, Response, NextFunction} from 'express';
import type {VhostRouter} from '../../../lib/vhost';
import * as middleware from '../../../middleware';
import {resourceHelpers} from '../../../middleware/oauth/enforceUserPermissions';
import {routers} from '../../vhost';
import {SCOPES} from '../../../lib/logic/oauth/scopes';
import {
  requirePublicBearer,
  resolvePublicOAuthIdentity,
} from '../../../lib/logic/ai/mcp-server/page-automation/middleware';
import {shapePublicChatCompletionsErrors} from '../../../lib/logic/ai/public-llm-proxy/shape-public-llm-errors';
import {requirePublicLlmProxyFeatureFlag} from '../../../lib/logic/ai/public-llm-proxy/feature-flag';
import {publicLlmChatCompletionsRateLimit} from '../../../lib/logic/ai/public-llm-proxy/rate-limits';
import {restrictPublicChatScopes} from '../../../lib/logic/ai/public-llm-proxy/restrict-public-ai-scope';
import {
  enforceChatCompletionsModelAllowlist,
  restrictPublicLlmOAuthApplications,
  restrictPublicLlmWorkspaceAi,
  resolvePublicLlmWorkspace,
  resolvePublicKeyArea,
} from '../../../lib/logic/ai/public-llm-proxy/middleware';
import {forwardToLlmProxy} from '../../../lib/logic/ai/public-llm-proxy/forward-to-llm-proxy';
import {openaiChatError} from '../../../lib/logic/ai/public-llm-proxy/error-response';
import logger from '../../../lib/logger';
// Type augmentations for req.publicLlmKeyArea and req.pageAutomationOAuthUserId
import '../../../lib/logic/ai/public-llm-proxy/types';
import '../../../lib/logic/ai/mcp-server/page-automation/types';

export async function publicLlmChatCompletionsHandler(
  req: Request,
  res: Response
): Promise<void> {
  const userId = req.pageAutomationOAuthUserId;
  const keyArea = req.publicLlmKeyArea;
  const workspaceId = req.publicLlmWorkspaceId;
  if (!userId || !keyArea || !workspaceId) {
    logger.error(
      '[public-llm-proxy] chat completions handler reached without OAuth userId, workspaceId, or keyArea — middleware order is wrong'
    );
    res.status(500).json(openaiChatError('Internal server error.'));
    return;
  }

  logger.info('[public-llm-proxy] chat completions request received', {
    keyArea,
    model: (req.body as {model?: unknown} | undefined)?.model,
  });

  await forwardToLlmProxy({
    req,
    res,
    targetPath: '/v1/chat/completions',
    keyArea,
    identity: {userId, workspaceId},
    errorEnvelope: 'openai',
  });
}

function rejectAccessTokenQueryParam(
  req: Request,
  res: Response,
  next: NextFunction
): void {
  if (req.query.access_token) {
    res
      .status(401)
      .json(
        openaiChatError(
          'Use the Authorization header instead of query parameters to authenticate.',
          'authentication_error'
        )
      );
    return;
  }
  next();
}

function publicLlmChatCompletionsErrorHandler(
  err: unknown,
  _req: Request,
  res: Response,
  _next: NextFunction
): void {
  if ((err as Error).name === 'OAuthUnauthorizedInsufficientPermissionsError') {
    res
      .status(403)
      .json(
        openaiChatError(
          'You no longer have permission to use AI for this workspace.',
          'permission_error'
        )
      );
    return;
  }
  logger.errorWithStack(
    '[public-llm-proxy] unhandled chat completions route error',
    err instanceof Error ? err : new Error(String(err))
  );
  res.status(500).json(openaiChatError('Internal server error.'));
}

export default function (app: VhostRouter) {
  app.post(
    {
      path: '/api/ai/v1/chat/completions',
      routers: [routers.defaultApp, routers.oauthAppV2],
    },
    // 0. Reshape 401/403/429 from shared middleware to OpenAI error envelope.
    shapePublicChatCompletionsErrors,
    // 1. Reject ?access_token= query param — use Authorization header instead.
    rejectAccessTokenQueryParam,
    // 2. Extract Bearer, fail fast on missing token.
    requirePublicBearer,
    // 3. Validate token against Mongo, populate req.oauthAuth and req.pageAutomationOAuthUserId.
    resolvePublicOAuthIdentity,
    // 4. Only configured OAuth applications may use this API.
    restrictPublicLlmOAuthApplications('openai'),
    // 5. Statsig gate FIRST (before rate limit).
    requirePublicLlmProxyFeatureFlag(),
    // 6. Require a workspace-scoped grant and load its active workspace.
    resolvePublicLlmWorkspace,
    // 6a. Respect the workspace-level AI toggle before authorizing or using LLM capacity.
    restrictPublicLlmWorkspaceAi('openai'),
    // 7. Require active owner-permission enforcement for the granted workspace.
    middleware.oauth.loadUser,
    middleware.oauth.enforceUserPermissions({
      action: 'read',
      getResource: resourceHelpers.workspace,
      failClosed: true,
      requireEnforceMode: true,
    }),
    // 8. Rate limit per resolved workspace.
    publicLlmChatCompletionsRateLimit,
    // 9. OAuth scope enforcement — fails 403 if token doesn't have ai:write.
    restrictPublicChatScopes([SCOPES.AI_WRITE]),
    // 10. Derive internal keyArea from the OAuth application.
    resolvePublicKeyArea,
    // 11. Reject models not in the per-keyArea allowlist.
    enforceChatCompletionsModelAllowlist,
    // 12. Forward to internal llm-proxy.
    middleware.asyncWrapNamedFunction(publicLlmChatCompletionsHandler),
    // 13. Route-scoped error handler.
    publicLlmChatCompletionsErrorHandler
  );
}
